# Public OpenWeather documentation samples

These files were downloaded only to inspect the published History Bulk schema.
They describe **London, 1–2 July 2020**, not Minnesota/ATR301 in 2018.
Do not use them as external demo inputs or as model evaluation data.

Original sample downloads are linked from https://openweathermap.org/api/history-bulk .
`sample_manifest.json` records their exact URLs, byte sizes, content types and SHA256 hashes.
No paid order or authenticated API request was made.

See `app/docs/openweather_review.md` from the repository root for observed field availability and limitations.
